ai-citation-tactics.title: AI citation tactics — platform-specific playbook
ai-citation-tactics.description: Only ~11% of cited domains overlap between ChatGPT and Perplexity. A single 'be helpful' strategy is incomplete — each platform rewards different work. Pick your niche to see priority order + concrete tactics per platform.
ai-citation-tactics.upsellAio: → Use the AI Overview passage optimizer to score your content
ai-citation-tactics.upsellPersonSchema: → Generate Person schema for your authors

ai-robots.title: AI-bot robots.txt audit
ai-robots.description: Check whether your robots.txt explicitly addresses ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and the 10+ other AI crawlers. Generates a copy-paste patch for the ones you're not covering.
ai-robots.whyTitle: Why a wildcard block isn't enough
ai-robots.whyBody: Most AI crawlers explicitly document that User-agent: * alone doesn't opt content out of their training set — they require their vendor-specific UA to be named. GPTBot ignores the wildcard for training purposes. Google-Extended is a separate knob from Googlebot. Applebot-Extended is separate from Applebot. This tool audits each known AI UA individually and generates the exact directives you need.
ai-robots.patchHint: Default is Disallow (opt out of training). Flip Disallow → Allow for any bot you want to permit.
ai-robots.allAddressedHint: Every known AI crawler has an explicit rule in your robots.txt. No patch needed.

anchor-distribution.title: Anchor-text distribution
anchor-distribution.description: Paste any URL — we extract every anchor, classify internal vs external, surface the most-used phrases. Catch over-optimization (>5% exact-match), missing brand variation, sparse internal linking.

bing.title: Bing Webmaster Tools
bing.description: Free Bing organic data — top queries, top pages, crawl issues, URL submission. Bing's API is free and lower-quota than IndexNow but returns proper search-analytics rows.
bing.step1: Go to <link>Bing Webmaster Tools</link> and sign in.
bing.step2: Settings (gear) → API Access → Generate API key.
bing.step3: Copy and paste it below — it's stored locally.
bing.indexnowHint: Want to push fresh URLs to Bing instantly? Use the <link>IndexNow tool</link> — same engine, simpler protocol, no key needed.
bing.noSites: No sites verified in Bing Webmaster yet — add one in the <link>Bing dashboard</link>.
bing.noIssues: Clean — Bing reports no crawl issues for this site.
bing.submitted: ✓ Submitted {count} {count, plural, one {URL} other {URLs}} to Bing.

branded-split.title: Branded vs non-branded GSC split
branded-split.description: Compare branded queries vs non-branded over 28 days, with delta vs prior 28 days. Brand drops mean a reputation problem; non-brand drops mean a content/SEO problem — different fixes.
branded-split.setupTitle: Connect Google Search Console to use this
branded-split.setupDetail: Splitting branded from non-branded queries needs the real query data from Search Console — a brand drop and a non-brand drop have completely different causes.
branded-split.errorNoBrand: Add at least one brand term (comma-separated).

domain-overview.title: Domain overview
domain-overview.description: Run every signal we can check ourselves — HTTPS, security headers, schema, on-page basics, indexed-pages estimate, robots/sitemap. For paid metrics (DA, backlink count, organic traffic estimate), we link you to the best free external checkers.
domain-overview.externalTitle: Check what we can't (free external tools)
domain-overview.externalHint: DA / DR, real backlink counts, organic traffic estimates, and full SSL/security grades require third-party indexes. These links open with {host} pre-filled where possible.

checkers.semrush: Authority score, organic traffic est. (free with signup)
checkers.wayback: How long the domain has been live + how it looked
checkers.whois: Registrar, registration date, owner if not private
checkers.sslLabs: TLS / SSL certificate grade A+ to F

eeat-audit.title: E-E-A-T audit
eeat-audit.description: Score any URL on Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trust signals — Google's quality-rater framework. We detect bylines, bios, schema, citations, and trust pages, then AI writes a concrete fix punch list.

gbp-reply.title: GBP review reply AI
gbp-reply.description: Pull reviews, AI drafts a reply each, you approve or edit, post via the GBP API.
gbp-reply.scopeMissing: Google Business Profile scope not granted. Reconnect Google with the business.manage scope under Settings → Google.
gbp-reply.noLocations: No GBP locations on this Google account. Verify a location on <link>business.google.com</link> first, then come back.
gbp-reply.noReviews: No reviews for this location yet.
gbp-reply.posted: Reply posted to Google Business Profile.
gbp-reply.noDraft: AI didn't draft a reply for this one (likely above the per-run cap of 20). Re-run to draft.

headers.title: HTTP headers + redirect chain
headers.description: Follow every redirect step-by-step + show full HTTP response headers at each hop. Critical for canonicalization + redirect debugging.
headers.errorStopped: Stopped after {count} {count, plural, one {hop} other {hops}}: {url} {reason}. A public URL that redirects into a private address is a known way to make a server fetch something it shouldn't, so this tool won't follow it.

health-check.title: SEO health check
health-check.description: One URL → every checker we have, run in parallel: on-page audit, robots/sitemap, hreflang, security headers, Core Web Vitals, image audit, redirect chain. Save the result to compare before / after later.

msg.observatoryLow: Mozilla Observatory grade {grade} ({score}/100). Multiple security headers need attention.
msg.sslLow: SSL Labs grade {grade}. Renew or upgrade your TLS configuration.
msg.lowPerformance: PageSpeed performance score {score}/100 — below 50 indicates serious issues.
msg.lcpPoor: LCP {seconds}s — Google's "poor" threshold is >4s. Identify the LCP element and fix it.
msg.clsPoor: CLS {cls} — layout shift exceeds Google's "poor" threshold of 0.25.
msg.missingAlt: {count} {count, plural, one {image} other {images}} missing alt text.
msg.oversize: {count} {count, plural, one {image} other {images}} > 200KB. Compress or convert to WebP.
msg.noDimensions: {count} {count, plural, one {image} other {images}} missing width/height — causes CLS.
msg.redirectChain: {count} hops to reach the final URL. More than 2 wastes crawl budget + slows the page.

health-check.findingsHint: Sorted by severity. Each line is something a real SEO would fix.
health-check.snapshotsHint: Saved snapshots show up at <link>/snapshots</link> where you can compare two scans of the same URL side-by-side (before / after speed work, redesigns, migrations).

hub.recentTitle: Pick up where you left off

indexnow.title: IndexNow submitter
indexnow.description: Push fresh URLs to Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam in seconds. Free, no API key required — just one verification file on your server.
indexnow.step1: Save a plain-text file to the root of your site at {path}
indexnow.step2: The file must contain exactly this string (no quotes, no whitespace):
indexnow.step3: Submit URLs below. Engines will fetch the key file to verify ownership before accepting submissions.
indexnow.sameKey: Same key is reused across all your sites. Don't change it once set up.
indexnow.urls: URLs (one per line, all from the host above)
indexnow.note202: Note: status 202 means engines accepted the request but couldn't verify the key file. Check <link>{keyUrl}</link> is reachable.
indexnow.verified: ✓ Key file verified — engines can confirm ownership.

intent-classifier.title: Bulk search-intent classifier
intent-classifier.description: Paste up to 200 queries — AI classifies each as informational / navigational / commercial / transactional / local + suggests the best content format. Falls back to regex heuristics if AI isn't configured.

link-recommender.title: AI internal-link recommender
link-recommender.description: Paste a draft + the site you'll publish on. The tool crawls existing pages, ranks them by relevance, and the AI proposes specific anchor texts + which existing page each link should point to.
link-recommender.skipUrl: Skip URL (the page you're writing for, optional)
link-recommender.draft: Draft (paste markdown or plain text, ≥100 chars)
link-recommender.draftPlaceholder: # How to start a vegan meal-planning routine\n\nFor most people...
link-recommender.pickedFrom: Picked from {count} relevant existing pages on the site.
link-recommender.noSuggestions: No fitting internal links found. Either the site doesn't have closely-related pages yet, or the AI couldn't place one confidently.

perf-budget.title: Performance budget enforcement
perf-budget.description: Define byte / request / Core Web Vitals budgets. We crawl the URL, measure actuals, and surface every line item that's over budget. Use to catch regressions before they hit prod.
perf-budget.errorNoPsi: PageSpeed Insights didn't return data. Check the URL or configure your Google API key in Settings.
perf-budget.errorNoSignals: No measurable signals returned from PageSpeed. Check that the URL is publicly reachable.

pixel-preview.title: Pixel preview
pixel-preview.description: Type below — see exactly how Google will render the search result on mobile and desktop. Length warnings update live.
pixel-preview.tip1: · Title tag ≤ 60 characters, primary keyword near the front, brand at the end
pixel-preview.tip2: · Meta description ≤ 160 characters with a value prop + soft CTA
pixel-preview.tip3: · Don't pad with keyword variations — write for click-through
pixel-preview.tip4: · Each page needs a unique title + description; duplicates hurt
pixel-preview.descriptionEmpty: Your meta description appears here. It influences click-through rate, not rankings directly.

redirects-manager.title: Redirect manager + 404 monitor
redirects-manager.description: Central CRUD for 301/302/307/308/410 redirects. Plus a 404 log — every page visitors hit that doesn't exist, with one-click 'create redirect from this hit' resolution. POST /api/v1/track-404 from your site to log automatically.
redirects-manager.errorTarget: Target must be absolute URL or /-prefixed path.
redirects-manager.exportHint: Export rules to your server as Nginx / Apache / Next.js blocks via the Migration Map tool. This page is the source of truth.
redirects-manager.no404: No 404s logged. POST {body} from your site to {endpoint} to log automatically.

trending.title: Trending content ideas
trending.description: Type a topic. We pull rising signals from Google Trends, autocomplete a-z expansion, People Also Ask, related searches, and Reddit threads — then AI synthesises 10-15 publish-ready ideas tied to specific signals. Free, no paid keyword API.
trending.topicPlaceholder: vegan meal planning · serverless databases · pickleball
trending.ideasHint: Ranked roughly by signal strength × novelty.

wayback.title: Wayback Machine timeline
wayback.description: See how a page evolved over years. Pulls Internet Archive CDX (free, no key). Critical when investigating ranking drops, content changes by competitors, or your own historical content.
wayback.noSnapshots: No archived snapshots for this URL.

youtube.title: YouTube keyword research
youtube.description: Real video data from YouTube — view counts, channels, recurring tag phrases. The free YouTube Data API gives 100 searches a day and zero extra cost.
youtube.step1: Go to the <link>YouTube Data API page</link> in Google Cloud Console.
youtube.step2: Enable the API for any project.
youtube.step3: Credentials → Create credentials → API key. Restrict it to YouTube Data API v3 if you like.
youtube.step4: Paste it below — we store it locally only.
youtube.phrasesHint: Aggregated from video titles + tags. Heavier weight = more recurring across creators.
